newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks to open cautiously.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks to open cautiously.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks, which closed higher on Friday, were seen opening slowly on Monday, as investors wait to see if market liquidity would improve, brokers said.

"Buyers were seen towards the end of last week, which closed up. But they are not going to charge in and boost prices if sellers are seen holding back," said Sanjeeva Gunewardena of Ceylinco Stock Brokers.
On Friday, the all share index closed 2.3 points up at 730.2 on turnover of 36.8 million rupees.
